podEn: General Magic and the Soul of Tech
podZh: General Magic and the Soul of Tech
tEn: Unintended Consequences: Taking Responsibility for What We Build
tZh: 意外后果：为我们所构建之物承担责任
sEn: Tony Fadell reflects on the unintended consequences of the technologies he helped create and how to build responsibly in the age of AI.
sZh: 托尼·法德尔反思他参与创造的技术所带来的意外后果，以及如何在人工智能时代负责任地创新。

consensus.en: Technology always brings unintended consequences; creators must return as voices of reason.
consensus.zh: 技术总会带来意外后果，创造者必须回归并成为理性的声音。

consensus.en: Healthy users make healthy customers, which drives long-term business value.
consensus.zh: 健康的用户造就健康的客户，从而带来长期商业价值。

consensus.en: AI should supercharge humans, not replace them; keep humans in the loop.
consensus.zh: AI 应增强人类而非取代人类，必须保持人类在环。

consensus.en: Domain-specific AI with targeted data outperforms general-purpose know-it-all models.
consensus.zh: 针对特定领域、使用定向数据的 AI 优于通用型“万事通”模型。

consensus.en: Digital convenience is good, but always-on connectivity creates addiction and distraction.
consensus.zh: 数字便利是好事，但始终在线的连接会带来成瘾和分心。

consensus.en: Government regulation is necessary to tame social media and AI harms.
consensus.zh: 政府监管对于遏制社交媒体和 AI 的危害是必要的。

contrarian.en: Consumers won't pay for AI assistants, so you'll become the product again.
contrarian.zh: 消费者不会为 AI 助手付费，所以你会再次成为被售卖的产品。

contrarian.en: AI coding tools produce brittle code; human architects remain essential.
contrarian.zh: AI 编程工具生成的代码脆弱，人类架构师仍不可或缺。

contrarian.en: The web is not light or dark; it's a gray web where trust is impossible.
contrarian.zh: 网络并非光明或黑暗，而是一个灰色网络，信任无法建立。

contrarian.en: Anonymity online doesn't work long-term; identity is needed for trust.
contrarian.zh: 在线匿名长期行不通，信任需要身份标识。

contrarian.en: AI agents as assistants will fail because people don't know how to delegate.
contrarian.zh: AI 智能体作为助手会失败，因为人们不知道如何委派任务。

contrarian.en: Cognitive surrender to AI is a bigger risk than AI itself.
contrarian.zh: 对 AI 的认知投降比 AI 本身的风险更大。

turns.en: Hi, this is Mike Stern and this is Tom Hirs Hersen. Welcome to General Magic in the soul of tech. We believed we were building something that would change the world and in some ways we did. In others, we didn't understand what we were setting in motion. The story of general magic isn't over. We're still living inside what it started. We have a special guest today, Tony Fadell, who was both a heart and soul of General Magic in the early days when he was a young engineer and who has remained on the scene as one of the most important enablers of innovative and human-centered innovation today. It's a pleasure to see Tony and interview him. You know, the word prodigy maybe is overused, but in Tony's case, it fits. I'm not sure what the right term is for someone who was a prodigy and decades later maintains that same brilliance and in Tony's case not just intelligence and a wizard at engineering but really a far-sighted human being someone who cares about the human side of things. So a delight to see you Tony and with that Mike fire away.

turns.zh: 我出去散步。我锻炼时不听音乐。散步时，也许有时候会听，看情况。但我尽量确保让我的大脑得到休息。这不只是睡觉的时候。你必须让大脑休息，你必须能够思考和反思。

turns.en: And I think we need — and this is to my point about more tools — we need more tools that help us understand our digital consumption patterns, like we do for our physical food consumption patterns. We need weights, you know, scales for that. We need to know what's healthy. We need nutritional facts. What's healthy? What's not, digitally? Just like we do with food. We need all of these different things. The government can get involved. The app stores need to get involved, and that allows us to make better choices.
turns.zh: 我认为我们需要——这就回到我关于更多工具的观点——我们需要更多工具，帮助我们理解自己的数字消费模式，就像我们对待实体食物消费模式那样。我们需要重量，你知道，需要秤。我们需要知道什么是健康的。我们需要营养标签。在数字层面，什么健康？什么不健康？就像我们对待食物一样。我们需要所有这些不同的东西。政府可以参与进来。应用商店也需要参与进来，这样我们才能做出更好的选择。

turns.en: But we do need to pull back, and you need to understand — just like you can't eat out of the refrigerator 10 times a day — you've got to make sure that you understand that this is a refrigerator and it can have good and bad food inside it, your smartphone. And you should only be eating healthy food a few times a day, not all the junk food. Get rid of the junk food. So the first thing is, you know, be the change you want to see.
turns.zh: 但我们确实需要退后一步，你需要明白——就像你不能一天十次从冰箱里拿东西吃——你必须明白，你的智能手机就是一个冰箱，里面可能有好的食物，也有坏的食物。你应该一天只吃几次健康食品，而不是全是垃圾食品。把垃圾食品扔掉。所以第一件事就是，你知道，成为你想看到的改变。

turns.en: Sounds like an assignment for your company.
turns.zh: 听起来像是给你公司布置的一项任务。

turns.en: Oh, maybe. Obviously, it's kind of great.
turns.zh: 哦，也许吧。显然，这挺不错的。

turns.en: That's better than politics for me. In politics — let's put it that way.
turns.zh: 对我来说，这比政治好。在政治里——就这么说吧。

turns.en: Well, that's what we used to say on the PR side when someone would say, why doesn't Magic App have this feature in it? Jane Anderson would say, wonderful opportunity for a developer. So there you go.
turns.zh: 嗯，这就是我们在公关那边常说的，当有人说，为什么 Magic App 没有这个功能？简·安德森会说，这对开发者来说是个绝妙的机会。所以就是这样。

turns.en: Yeah, exactly. Wonderful opportunity.
turns.zh: 是的，没错。绝妙的机会。

turns.en: I know we have to let you go, but just wanted to thank you so much for being with us and having a conversation.
turns.zh: 我知道我们得放你走了，但只是想非常感谢你和我们在一起，进行这场对话。

turns.en: Well, thank you guys. It was always good to see you guys.
turns.zh: 嗯，谢谢你们。见到你们总是很高兴。

turns.zh: 感谢收听 General Magic 和 Soul of Tech 播客。请关注我们的 Substack，获取更多访谈和文章，网址是 spellboundproductions.substack.com。
